title: Mercury CEO Immad Akhund says the fintech hit $1B in annualized revenue, up ~50% YoY, has more than 450K customers, and is launching a payroll service (Eric Newcomer/Newcomer)
summary: Eric Newcomer / Newcomer: Mercury CEO Immad Akhund says the fintech hit $1B in annualized revenue, up ~50% YoY, has more than 450K customers, and is launching a payroll service — I sat down with Mercury CEO Immad Akhund — We just published my conversation with Mercury CEO Immad Akhund on the Newcomer Podcast.
